desc: Prove that \(f(L,R)\) equals the number of maximal consecutive blocks among the distinct subarray values.
Derive each value's contribution as \(\max(0,\mathrm{last}[x]-\mathrm{last}[x-1])\) for a fixed right endpoint.
Implement the \(O(N)\)-time, \(O(N)\)-space right-endpoint sweep with correct updates and boundary handling.
Verify the implementation on all provided samples and relevant edge cases.
